title: A comment the board keeps as comments/<k>.json, written only by use-board.py

text.description: Markdown a person reads; no code reads it for data

holders.description: the sessions that hold the task from now on, replacing every earlier value; empty when no one does

asks.description: on a BLOCKED, that the owner answers it, not the manager

options.description: on a BLOCKED, the answers it offers, which a reader numbers from 1 in this order

live_runs.description: how many live sessions the checks run in one worktree may start in all, replacing every earlier value

decision.description: one binding sentence; a DECIDED without it is an event, which binds and answers nothing

by.description: who decided: owner, else the deciding session's name

one_way.description: a decision hard to undo, which a worker's binds only once the manager or the owner repeats or supersedes it

supersedes.description: the url of the decision it replaces, anywhere in the same root's tree

answers.description: the url of the BLOCKED it settles, on the same task
